observations: Order is the all-box puzzle: two forks, each with a dead end to do first (fork-1 Nitro room, fork-2 crystal block before the one-way drop).
Body-slam walls are count banks: 22 of 62 main boxes in two hazard-free walls; the risk is in the routing (dead end, one-way hole).
Explosives frame single rewards (the ? between Nitros; the ? stack beside a Nitro stack), never guard big groups.
Both Aku boxes come early; the second sits at fork 1, right before the Nitro room.
Secret content does not tax the all-box goal: the secret course holds only 3 Nitros cleared remotely by the green !.
The Nitro switch sits at the start of the finale beside C3, so the count is settled before the last segment.
Teaching beats sit at checkpoints and in the bonus (striped sandwich at C1; ! switch, steel-hemmed slam, arrow-to-ceiling bounce in the bonus).
Main density 11/16/31/4: a spike from the two walls, then a navigation-only finale.
Every box group sits in a calm room between hazard tunnels: hazard corridor, then payout room.
openQuestions: Fork-1 Nitro room count (12) is a residual of the two wall estimates.
Bonus B-x (3 boxes) unlocated; outline boxes' count status unknown.
S3-e may contain one striped box.
Whether the S2-b ? floats or sits between the Nitros on the floor.

B-a's outline boxes (>=4) carry count 0 because whether they count is unresolved; they may be the 3 unknown boxes. Counted clusters sum to 79 = main 62 + bonus 14 (B-b 8 + B-x 3 + B-c 3) + secret 3.
